
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper19" title="发布于 2026-03-11 18:50">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MAF快速入门（19）给Agent Skill添加脚本执行能力</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202603/381412-20260311184847453-1295599471.png" alt="MAF快速入门（19）给Agent Skill添加脚本执行能力" class="desc_img">
        根据上一篇我们知道，Agent Skill就是大模型随时翻阅的说明文档，它还可以包含一些资源文件，而脚本就是其中的一种重要资源。本文介绍了Agent Skill的脚本执行，脚本 和 工具的对比，最后通过一个MAF中Agent Skill 结合 PowerShell脚本执行 的系统运维案例介绍如何集成脚本执行，相信会对你有所帮助。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>最近我一直在跟着圣杰的《<span>.NET+AI智能体开发进阶<span>》课程学习MAF开发多智能体工作流，我强烈推荐你也上车跟我一起出发！</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper18" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2"><span>上一篇</span></a><span>，我们初步学习了Agent Skill的基本概念以及在MAF中实现了一个Agent Skill的案例<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>。本篇，我们来了解下Agent Skill如何集成脚本执行能力。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>1 Agent Skill中的执行脚本</strong></h1>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>根据上一篇我们知道，Agent Skill就是大模型随时翻阅的<span>说明文档<span>，它还可以包含一些资源文件，而脚本就是其中的一种重要资源。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>skill/
├── SKILL.md    # 必需：指令 + 元数据
├── scripts/    # 可选：可执行代码
├── references/ # 可选：文档资料
└── assets/     # 可选：模板、资源文件</pre>
</div>
<h3><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px 0px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;2 4 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>scripts子目录</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span><span>这些脚本会被放在其所属skill目录下的scripts子目录下，不管它是BASH脚本，PowerShell脚本，又或者是Python/C<a class="wx_topic_link" data-topic="1"><span>#代码</span></a><span>，只要是Agent所在客户/服务端能够执行的都可以。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span><span>总结，<span><strong>Skills不仅让Agent知道处理规则（SKILL.md + references），还能让Agent直接上手处理（scripts）</strong><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span><span>工具 vs 技能</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span><span>工具（Tool）是一种<span>能力<span>，而技能（Skill）是一种<span>知识<span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>比如，自己开发一个PowerShellTools，给模型提供一些run shell的能力，我们通过注册到 ChatOptions.Tools 完成加载。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>又如，自己定义一个系统运维Skill，给模型提供一些系统运维的知识，我们通过注册到AIContextProviders完成加载。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []">知识指导行为，而非工具限定行为。</span></span></strong></p>
<h1><strong><span>2 快速开始：MAF中集成Shell执行能力<strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;6 3 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-top: 16px;margin-bottom: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;color: rgb(0, 179, 139);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Lantinghei SC\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Yahei\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Sans Serif\&quot;, \&quot;WenQuanYi Micro Hei\&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.544px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><br></span></strong></span></strong></h1>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">假设我们有这样一个需求：某企业开发了一个IT助手Agent，它运行在每个员工的笔记本电脑上，可以回答用户关于系统方面的一些问题并加以分析给出建议。</p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>例如，很多员工发现自己的笔记本电脑最近越来越慢了，又或者发现内存一直高负载 等等，在以前员工会直接联系IT部的某位员工，而现在IT部将自身的运维经验封装为了一个Skill并通过Agent直接回复员工。</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>以终为始，我们的Agent应用的解决方案长这样子：这是一个.NET控制台应用程序，其中有一个skills目录，存放了系统运维领域的知识，这是IT部呕心沥血整理的“<span>宝典<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>”<span><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202603/381412-20260311184216516-539637238.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong><span><span>系统运维Skill</span></span></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">首先，我们创建这个SKILL.md，内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>---
name: system-ops
description: 系统运维诊断技能。适用于系统健康检查、磁盘空间分析、进程资源监控、故障排查等系统运维场景。包含可执行的诊断脚本。
---

# 系统运维（System Operations）

## 可用诊断脚本

以下脚本位于本技能的 `scripts/` 目录，可通过 `run_shell` 工具执行：

| 脚本 | 用途 | 执行命令 |
|------|------|--------|
| check-system-info.ps1 | 获取系统基本信息（OS、CPU、内存） | 
| check-disk-usage.ps1 | 检查磁盘使用情况和剩余空间 | 
| check-top-processes.ps1 | 查看 CPU/内存占用 Top 进程 |

## 运维检查流程

1. **基础检查**：先执行 `check-system-info.ps1` 获取系统概况
2. **针对性诊断**：根据用户问题，选择性执行磁盘或进程检查脚本
3. **分析报告**：综合脚本输出和故障排查指南，给出诊断结论和建议
4. **故障排查**：如需深入排查，参考 [references/troubleshooting-guide.md](references/troubleshooting-guide.md)

## 告警阈值

| 指标 | 正常 | 警告 | 严重 |
|------|------|------|------|
| CPU 使用率 | &lt;70% | 70-90% | &gt;90% |
| 内存使用率 | &lt;80% | 80-95% | &gt;95% |
| 磁盘使用率 | &lt;70% | 70-90% | &gt;90% |
| 单进程 CPU | &lt;30% | 30-60% | &gt;60% |</pre>
</div>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">由于该Skill还定义了引用的资源，所以我们还需要添加：</p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong>（1）参考文件：故障自查指南</strong></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>说明：这是一个markdown文件。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># 故障排查指南

## CPU 持续高负载

1. 通过 `check-top-processes.ps1` 识别高占用进程
2. 判断是否为预期行为（如编译、数据处理）
3. 如为异常进程，建议：
   - 记录进程信息（PID、启动时间、命令行）
   - 联系应用负责人确认
   - 必要时可终止进程：`Stop-Process -Id &lt;PID&gt;`

## 内存不足

1. 检查物理内存使用率（通过 `check-system-info.ps1`）
2. 识别内存大户（通过 `check-top-processes.ps1`）
3. 常见原因：
   - 内存泄漏：进程内存持续增长
   - 缓存过多：数据库或应用缓存未限制
4. 缓解措施：
   - 重启内存泄漏进程
   - 调整应用缓存配置
   - 考虑扩容

## 磁盘空间不足

1. 通过 `check-disk-usage.ps1` 确认各盘使用率
2. 清理建议（按优先级）：
   - 清理临时文件
   - 清理日志文件（保留近 7 天）
   - 清理 NuGet 包缓存：`dotnet nuget locals all --clear`
3. 长期方案：配置日志轮转、扩容磁盘</pre>
</div>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong>（2）脚本文件：PowerShell脚本</strong></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>说明：这里主要在Windows系统中执行脚本，所以选择了PowerShell。</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>脚本1：获取系统基本信息</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># check-system-info.ps1 — 获取系统基本信息
Write-Host "=== 系统基本信息 ==="
Write-Host "计算机名: $env:COMPUTERNAME"
Write-Host "操作系统: $([System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::OSDescription)"
Write-Host "处理器架构: $([System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::ProcessArchitecture)"
Write-Host "逻辑处理器数: $([Environment]::ProcessorCount)"

$os = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($os) {
    $totalMemGB = [math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize / 1MB, 2)
    $freeMemGB = [math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory / 1MB, 2)
    $usedMemGB = [math]::Round($totalMemGB - $freeMemGB, 2)
    $memUsagePercent = [math]::Round(($usedMemGB / $totalMemGB) * 100, 1)
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "=== 内存信息 ==="
    Write-Host "总内存: ${totalMemGB} GB"
    Write-Host "已使用: ${usedMemGB} GB ($memUsagePercent%)"
    Write-Host "可用: ${freeMemGB} GB"
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== 系统运行时间 ==="
$uptime = (Get-Date) - (Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime
Write-Host "已运行: $($uptime.Days) 天 $($uptime.Hours) 小时 $($uptime.Minutes) 分钟"</pre>
</div>
<p>脚本2：检查系统磁盘使用信息</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># check-disk-usage.ps1 — 检查磁盘使用情况
Write-Host "=== 磁盘使用情况 ==="
Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DriveType=3" | ForEach-Object {
    $totalGB = [math]::Round($_.Size / 1GB, 2)
    $freeGB = [math]::Round($_.FreeSpace / 1GB, 2)
    $usedGB = [math]::Round($totalGB - $freeGB, 2)
    $usagePercent = if ($totalGB -gt 0) { [math]::Round(($usedGB / $totalGB) * 100, 1) } else { 0 }

    $status = if ($usagePercent -gt 90) { "🔴 严重" }
              elseif ($usagePercent -gt 70) { "🟡 警告" }
              else { "🟢 正常" }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "驱动器 $($_.DeviceID)"
    Write-Host "  总容量: ${totalGB} GB"
    Write-Host "  已使用: ${usedGB} GB ($usagePercent%)"
    Write-Host "  可用: ${freeGB} GB"
    Write-Host "  状态: $status"
}</pre>
</div>
<p>脚本3：查看资源占用Top10信息</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># check-top-processes.ps1 — 查看资源占用 Top 进程
param(
    [int]$Top = 10
)
Write-Host "=== CPU 占用 Top $Top 进程 ==="
Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First $Top | 
    Format-Table -Property @{N='进程名';E={$_.ProcessName}}, 
                           @{N='PID';E={$_.Id}}, 
                           @{N='CPU(s)';E={[math]::Round($_.CPU, 2)}}, 
                           @{N='内存(MB)';E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB, 1)}} -AutoSize |
    Out-String | Write-Host
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== 内存占用 Top $Top 进程 ==="
Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First $Top |
    Format-Table -Property @{N='进程名';E={$_.ProcessName}}, 
                           @{N='PID';E={$_.Id}}, 
                           @{N='内存(MB)';E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB, 1)}},
                           @{N='CPU(s)';E={[math]::Round($_.CPU, 2)}} -AutoSize |
    Out-String | Write-Host</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="3 3 []"><strong><span><span>自定义ShellTools</span></span></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">最近MAF发布了1.0.0-rc2，支持了Agent Skill，但其尚未开放原生的脚本执行能力，虽然在GitHub的demo中我已经看到了脚本执行的demo。但貌似已经revert了，因此我们再静静等候一阵。</p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">这里，我们通过自定义一个ShellTools来实现PowerShell的脚本执行能力：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShellTools
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> run_shell — 一个 Shell 工具做一切（含安全护栏）
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 🛡️ 安全护栏 1：危险命令黑名单</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>[] dangerousPatterns =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rm -rf /</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rm -rf /*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 删除根目录</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sudo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提权</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shutdown</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">reboot</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 系统操作</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&gt; /dev/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,                      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设备写入</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">:(){ :|:&amp; };:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,                <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Fork bomb</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mkfs.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 格式化</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dd if=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,                       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 磁盘覆写</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">format </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,                      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Windows 格式化</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">del /f /s /q</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Windows 递归删除</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ];

    [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">执行 Shell 命令。通过操作系统原生 Shell 执行命令（Windows 用 cmd，Linux/Mac 用 bash）。包含安全护栏：危险命令阻止、输出截断（50KB）、超时控制（60秒）。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RunShell(
        [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">要执行的 Shell 命令。例如：'pwsh -File /path/to/script.ps1' 或 'dir'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> command,
        [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">命令执行的工作目录（可选）。如果不指定，使用当前目录。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? workingDirectory = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 🛡️ 安全护栏 1：危险命令检查</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (dangerousPatterns.Any(d =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> command.Contains(d, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 安全拦截：检测到危险命令，已阻止执行。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 🔑 跨平台 Shell 适配：
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   Windows → cmd /c "command"   （原生命令提示符）
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   Linux/Mac → bash -c "command" （原生 Bash）
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 为什么不直接用 pwsh？
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   SKILL.md 中的命令已经是 "pwsh -File ..."
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   如果 RunShell 也用 pwsh -Command 包裹 → pwsh 套 pwsh（冗余嵌套）
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   用原生 shell 分发 → pwsh -File 直接执行，零嵌套</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> isWindows =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OperatingSystem.IsWindows();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> processInfo = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessStartInfo
            {
                FileName </span>= isWindows ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cmd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bash</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                Arguments </span>= isWindows ? $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/c {command}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> : $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-c \"{command.Replace(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>\<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\\\"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)}\<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                RedirectStandardOutput </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                RedirectStandardError </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                UseShellExecute </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                CreateNoWindow </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            };

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置工作目录</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(workingDirectory) &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Directory.Exists(workingDirectory))
            {
                processInfo.WorkingDirectory </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> workingDirectory;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> process =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Process.Start(processInfo);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (process == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 无法启动 Shell 进程</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> stdout =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> stderr =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> process.StandardError.ReadToEnd();

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 🛡️ 安全护栏 3：超时控制（60秒）</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">process.WaitForExit(60_000))
            {
                process.Kill(entireProcessTree: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 命令执行超时（60秒），已强制终止。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringBuilder();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(stdout))
            {
                result.AppendLine(stdout.Trim());
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(stderr))
            {
                result.AppendLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⚠️ stderr: {stderr.Trim()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (process.ExitCode != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                result.AppendLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⚠️ 退出码: {process.ExitCode}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> output = result.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ? result.ToString() : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(命令执行成功，无输出)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 🛡️ 安全护栏 2：输出截断（50KB）</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> maxOutputLength =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 50_000;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (output.Length &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> maxOutputLength)
            {
                output </span>= output[..maxOutputLength] + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n... (输出已截断，超过 50KB 上限)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> output;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 执行失败: {ex.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">这个ShellTools还考虑了必要的安全性，对于一些危险命令，会主动进行阻止，还对超时60s的操作进行了命令挂起。</p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="3 3 []"><strong><span><span>智能体调用Agent Skill</span></span></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">这里，让我们一步一步来实现在MAF中让智能体调用集成脚本执行的Skill。</p>
<p>（1）<strong>创建SkillsProvider</strong>：从文件中发现和加载Skills</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> skillsProvider = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FileAgentSkillsProvider(
    skillPath: Path.Combine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">skills</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    options: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FileAgentSkillsProviderOptions
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 🔑 自定义提示词：引导模型加载技能后使用 run_shell 执行脚本</span>
        SkillsInstructionPrompt = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        你可以使用以下技能获取领域知识和操作指引。
        每个技能提供专业指令、参考文档和可执行脚本。

        </span>&lt;available_skills&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
        </span>&lt;/available_skills&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

        工作流程：
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 当用户任务匹配技能描述时，使用 `load_skill` 加载该技能的完整指令
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 技能指令中会标明可用脚本及其执行命令
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 使用 `run_shell` 工具执行技能中标注的命令
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 需要时使用 `read_skill_resource` 读取参考资料

        重要原则：先加载知识，再执行操作。
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ FileAgentSkillsProvider 创建成功（知识层）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📂 自动注册工具: load_skill, read_skill_resource</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px 0px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">（2）<strong>创建Agent</strong>：注入SkillsProvider让其有Skill调用能力</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

{

<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>测试用例1</span></span></h3>
<p><span>用户：<span><span>帮我检查一下当前系统的整体健康状态，包括 CPU、内存和磁盘使用情况。</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Agent 会：
1. 识别属于 system-ops 领域 → load_skill("system-ops")
2. 从 SKILL.md 获取脚本执行命令
3. 依次调用 run_shell 执行诊断脚本
4. 根据告警阈值分析结果</pre>
</div>

<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>测试用例2</span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>危险脚本操作命令，验证Agent不会执行这些命令。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> dangerousTestCases = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[]
{
    (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rm -rf /</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">删除根目录</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sudo apt-get install malware</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">提权操作</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shutdown -s -t 0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">关机命令</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
};
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> (cmd, desc) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dangerousTestCases)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShellTools.RunShell(cmd);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 测试: {desc}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   命令: {cmd}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    Console.WriteLine();
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 测试正常命令</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> normalResult = ShellTools.RunShell(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Get-Date</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   命令: Get-Date</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   结果: {normalResult.Trim()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine();
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🛡️ 安全护栏验证完成：危险命令被正确拦截，正常命令正常执行。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>测试结果如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202603/381412-20260311184702077-1498795059.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>可以看到，安全防护栏正常工作，防止危险命令被Agent执行。</p>
<h1>3 小结</h1>
<p>本文介绍了Agent Skill的脚本执行，脚本 和 工具的对比，最后通过一个MAF中Agent Skill 结合 PowerShell脚本执行 的系统运维案例介绍如何集成脚本执行，相信会对你有所帮助。</p>
